name: Budget Planning & RBA
problem: Hospital budget planning requires consistent workflows, accurate calculations, and clear validation of budget changes.
contribution: Analyzed budget workflows, validated RBA data and budget adjustments, and checked business rules across related processes.
outcome: Supported more consistent budget workflows and validation of financial planning data.

name: Accounting Management
problem: Financial workflows require reliable transaction data, accurate calculations, and validation of business rules.
contribution: Reviewed transaction workflows, tested input validations and calculations, and documented discrepancies between actual and expected results.
outcome: Helped identify functional issues and improve the consistency of financial transaction processing.

name: Pharmacy Management
problem: Pharmacy workflows depend on consistent operational processes and accurate information across relevant system functions.
contribution: Worked with users to understand pharmacy processes, clarify functional requirements, and validate relevant system workflows.
outcome: Supported alignment between pharmacy user needs and expected system behavior.

name: Asset Management
problem: Hospital asset operations require traceable records, reliable inventory information, and practical identification workflows.
contribution: Validated asset records and inventory workflows, including barcode or QR-based identification processes, and followed up on operational issues.
outcome: Supported asset traceability and more reliable validation of asset management processes.

name: Training & Certification Management
problem: Training records and certification monitoring require clear verification rules, reliable filters, and accurate training-hour calculations.
contribution: Validated training schedules, certificate verification, monitoring filters, status indicators, and training-hour calculations by year.
outcome: Supported reliable training records and certification monitoring based on defined business rules.

name: Requirements Analysis & UAT
problem: Differences between user expectations and system behavior can cause implementation issues and delays during validation.
contribution: Translated user needs into functional requirements, coordinated with technical teams, supported testing and UAT, and tracked defects through follow-up and retesting.
outcome: Helped improve requirement clarity, defect visibility, and readiness for system implementation.
